# Review instructions

Review correctness before style. Focus on item loss/duplication, job resumption, worker concurrency, world safety, delivery overrides, ownership permissions and persistence compatibility.

Translations must preserve keys and numbered placeholders, use UTF-8, keep command and permission identifiers unchanged, and register new catalogs in languages.list. Do not translate user-defined names.

Require behavior-focused validation. Distinguish automated tests from real Minecraft gameplay checks. Flag untested assumptions and breaking changes to saved data.

MarekPoskrobko is the project owner and makes the final merge decision. AI review is advisory; do not auto-approve, merge, publish releases, or bypass repository rules.
